title: NepTunes .nepget widget manifest
description: Schema for manifest.json inside a .nepget bundle. Validate with: node widget-tools.mjs validate MyWidget.nepget

id.description: Reverse-domain identifier. Stable forever: it is the update-feed key and the TOFU pinning key.

version.description: major.minor.patch, numeric only. Must increase for the app to offer an update.

minNepTunesVersion.description: Minimum NepTunes version (major.minor.patch). If set and newer than the running app, the widget is refused at install time, flagged in Settings when already installed, and its gallery update is shown as blocked; an unparseable value counts as too new. Set it whenever the widget uses a permission, setting type or API added in a later NepTunes.

pointerTracking.description: Whether the widget receives pointer movement while the pointer is over its window.

alwaysVisible.description: Whether the widget remains visible when there is no active track.

supportsNoPlayback.description: Whether the widget can render meaningfully without active playback.

supportsMotionArtwork.description: Whether the widget supports motion artwork when available.

card.description: Whether the widget is a card clipped to the system widget shape.

authorPublicKey.description: Base64 of the 32 raw bytes of the author's Ed25519 public key (from widget-tools.mjs keygen). No ed25519: prefix. Required when the bundle ships a bundle.sig, and must equal bundle.sig.authorPublicKey; declaring it without a bundle.sig makes the bundle refuse to install. Pinned on first install; a change forces re-consent.

releaseNotes.description: What changed in this version. Copied into the update feed and shown in the update consent sheet.

resizable.description: Whether the user may resize the window, by dragging its edges or a resize handle the widget draws itself. Defaults to true when omitted. Does not affect NepTunes.setSize, which a fixed widget may still call to size itself to its own content.

pointerTracking.description: Report the pointer to this widget as pointermove {x, y} (viewport CSS pixels) and pointerleave events on NepTunes.on. Defaults to false. Needs NepTunes 4.1; older versions ignore the key.

alwaysVisible.description: Keep the widget on screen when nothing is playing, including when no music app is running, by default. Defaults to false: a widget is shown only while a track is playing or paused. For widgets whose content does not depend on the current track, such as listening stats or charts. Implies the widget handles nothing playing, so its settings offer Show: While music is playing / Always, set to Always until the user changes it. Still needs NepTunes running, Pro and desktop widgets turned on. Needs NepTunes 4.1; older versions ignore the key and hide the widget with playback.

supportsNoPlayback.description: The widget draws its own nothing-playing state (track is null), so its settings offer Show: While music is playing / Always. Unlike alwaysVisible it does not change the default, which stays While music is playing. Defaults to false: no choice is offered and the widget follows playback. Needs NepTunes 4.1; older versions ignore the key.

supportsMotionArtwork.description: The widget can show Apple Music motion (animated) artwork: NepTunes then exposes track.motionArtworkURL, a local video URL for a <video> element, and the widget's settings offer an Animated cover toggle, on by default. Needs the artwork permission. Defaults to false: the widget gets static artwork only. Needs NepTunes 4.1; older versions ignore the key and the widget shows static artwork.

card.description: The widget is one rounded panel: NepTunes clips the element with class nt-card to the corner macOS draws its own widgets with (a continuous corner, radius exposed as --nt-card-radius, 27px), and the widget's settings offer a Shadow switch, off by default, that draws a shadow around the card. Keep a gutter of at least 12px at the sides and top and 16px at the bottom, keep your own border-radius on .nt-card as the fallback, and draw no shadow of your own. Defaults to false: no shape, no shadow, no switch. Older versions ignore the key and the widget keeps its own border-radius.
